'''Satare''' is a "delicate" wine from the [[Age of Legends]].

==Description==
Next to nothing is known about Satare. When [[Graendal]] visits [[Sammael]] in [[Illian]], he serves her wine from the current [[Third Age|age]]. Graendal had hoped for a Satare or a [[Comolad]]. Due to her sipping her "here and now" wine while wishing for the others, it can be assumed that Satare and Comolad are both wines.{{ref/book|6|23}} They are likely named for the region or the grapes that produced them.
